flash_attn: 576 tokens per window (5184 in a global block), mma + online softmax
gemm_f16: proj, residual add in the epilogue
gemm_f16: fc1 with GELU in the epilogue, fc2 with the residual add
gemm_f16: fc2, residual add in the epilogue
gemm_f16: every convolution is a GEMM (im2col3, depth2space)
layernorm: norm1; also writes x + pos in f16
flash_attn: key mask for the padding tokens
layernorm: norm2 (post-norm), also writes tgt + pos
rpb_mlp: per query and head: bias of each key's row and column, from the box
layernorm: norm3; then dec norm + bbox MLP updates each box
gn_stats: two upsampling stages: conv3x3, GroupNorm(8), ReLU

svg.text: Figure 8: SAM 3 (Segment Anything 3), the image model with a text prompt, in the style of Vaswani et al. (2017): a ViT-L vision backbone with windowed attention and 2-D rotary embedding, a CLIP text encoder, a fusion encoder in which the image

tokens attend to the prompt, and a DETR-style decoder whose 200 queries each predict a box (refined after every layer), a score and a mask. Every box drawn as a product runs as an f16 tensor-core GEMM.
